briefing.geography: Two ruined stack wings lead from the archive entry to a deep warning shelf left empty for us, unless.
goals: Pan the entry hall seams and build a beacon at the west light stake.
Keep the next wing beacon powered through a whole warning and Static squall.
Restore a wing, survive twelve waves, then bank to keep the rescued pages.

An interrupted light hold must begin again with the next warning.
Lost runs keep no new restoration. Fully restored archives still require a fresh light hold.
